description: Saves the user's preferences under their personal code so they are selected by default in every new plan: tools they own and preferred non-consumable products (e.g. a tile brand, a specific boiler, a tap). Call when the user says what they own or which product they always want. Ticking 'have' and choosing an option in a saved plan updates preferences automatically. With no changes it just returns the current preferences.

materials.description: Preferred product per material key (non-consumables), e.g. {"floor_tiles": {name, price, store, url, country}}

tools_remove.description: Tool names to remove from owned

name: save_preferences
title: Save user preferences
